svg.text: #609 Enterprise Media, Gaming & Ad-Tech AI: DiT Video (420s → 28s) & Smart NPC Pool Sizing
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 15.0x Faster Video DiT (FP8 + SageAttention + TeaCache + 8-Step LoRA) · $0.25/Clip vs. $2.00 API (-87.5%)
1. Why Video DiT Is 100% Compute-Bound (420s → 28s)
✕ Unoptimized 14B Video DiT (5s 720p · 81 Frames · 50 Steps BF16)
• Full 3D Spatio-Temporal Attention across 32,400 tokens × 50 CFG steps
• Single-H100 Generation Time: 420.0 seconds (7.0 min/clip · $0.45/clip GPU cost)
✓ 4-Stage Video DiT Acceleration Stack (Wan2.1-14B / HunyuanVideo)
• 1. FP8 Linear + FlashAttention-3 / INT8 SageAttention: 420s → 195s (2.15x)
• 2. TeaCache / PAB Timestep Residual Caching: 195s → 82s (2.38x)
• 3. Consistency / PCM 8-Step Distillation LoRA (No CFG): 82s → 28.0s (2.93x)
• 4. Interactive Preview Mode: 4-GPU Ulysses×Ring (USP=4) → 7.2s/clip!
• Total Per-GPU Speedup: 15.0x (420s → 28.0s) · 10,000 Clips/Day on 32× H100!
2. Creative Factory + Gaming NPC Fleet Sizing
Pool A: 50,000 Ad Images/Day + Brand-Safety VLM Gate (4× L40S)
• Flux.1-Schnell FP8 (4-step) generates 1024×1024 images in 1.1s on L40S
• Automated VLM Brand-Safety Gate checks logo geometry, fingers & copyright
Pool B: 1,000 Concurrent Smart Gaming NPCs (Multi-LoRA + Kokoro TTS)
• Shared Lore Prefix Cache (94% hit) + 50 Persona LoRAs (#586) on 4× H200
• Sub-220ms voice turn latency via Kokoro-82M streaming TTS on 4× L40S
10,000 Video Clips/Day + 50K Images/Day TCO Comparison
• Commercial Video Gen API ($2.00/clip × 300K clips/mo): $600,000/month!
• Self-Hosted 32× H100 (Video) + 4× L40S (Image/Gate) = $77,400/mo ($0.25/clip, -87.1%!)
3. Why H100/B200 Beats L40S for Video DiT While L40S Wins for 4-Step Image Generation
• Video DiT (32,400 3D tokens) requires FlashAttention-3 Hopper WGMMA/TMA instructions on H100/B200 (2.8x faster than L40S).
• Conversely, 4-step Flux.1-Schnell FP8 image generation (4,096 tokens) fits in 24GB and achieves best Perf/$ on L40S-48GB.
